title: RELATIVE SCALING LAWS FOR LLMS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its case studies focus on academic knowledge domains in MMLU (STEM, humanities, social sciences, misc.), linguistic variation across regional Englishes, and AI risk behaviours.

findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of its investigation.
